description: Latest NO2/PM reading from the nearest IRCELINE station for a point, how it compares to WHO and EU limits, and whether the point sits inside the Antwerp low-emission zone. Measured values only.

lat.description: Latitude of the point. Must be inside Flanders or Brussels. Pair with lng.

lng.description: Longitude of the point. Pair with lat.

locationId.description: Id of one of the account's saved locations, from stadiq_locations. Use instead of lat/lng.

name: stadiq_air_quality
title: Air quality and low-emission-zone status
